title: narcissus bulbocodium var. gallicus
intro: Narcissus bulbocodium var. gallicus, commonly known as the Lily of France or the Small-flowered Daffodil, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to exhibit health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus bulbocodium var. gallicus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including galantamine, which has been shown to have a mild sedative effect and improve memory and cognitive performance. The bioactive constituents of this plant also include other alkaloids, such as lycorine and narciclasine, which may have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
